paragraphs: Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 92:3; Hyman says the name should read R' Yehoshua ben Levi. The Yalkut, Vayigash, remez 149, has the same reading, but omits the words ben Levi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ב״ר/פצ״ב־ג are contextually Bereshit Rabbah 92:3; קמט totals 149. Supplied רמו versus historical machine רמז is retained, with remez a contextual interpretation, not a silent Hebrew correction. Neither citation is freshly verified.

Hyman’s should-read changes Yoshiyah to Yehoshua. The Yalkut agreement is explicitly qualified by omission of ben Levi; the two statements do not assert identical full forms. Both abbreviated personal titles remain R', with the supplied heading unchanged and no identity merger.
